title: Multi-center lab chains
seo_description: Software for multi-center lab chains: run branches and collection centers in one system, compare revenue and turnaround, and keep one set of roles and permissions.

fields.hero_title: Run every center as one lab
fields.hero_lead: Branches, collection centers, and home collection in one system. Switch between centers, compare activity and revenue, and keep the same roles and permissions everywhere.
fields.screen_alt: Labora screen used by multi-center lab chains

pains.problem: Each branch runs its own way
pains.solution: One setup for tests, price lists, templates, and roles across every center.

pains.problem: No single view of the business
pains.solution: Revenue, dues, and referrals by center, day, and doctor.
Compare on-time rates across centers and find where time is lost.

fields.cta_title: See Labora set up for multi-center lab chains
fields.cta_text: Tell us how your lab works today. We will show you the same workflow in Labora, with your tests and price list.
